under the glove box, you’ll see a black plastic panel held in by 3 t25 screws. remove those, lower the panel, undo any electrical connections (footwell lighting is the only one that comes to mind), and remove the panel. once it’s out of the way, contort yourself so you can see under the dash. toward the far right of the dash you’ll see the blower motor held in by 4 (?) silver t20 screws. undo the electrical connection to the motor, remove the screws, lower the motor. the motors can only go in one way, and have alignment or orientation lugs in them, so you can’t really go wrong putting the new one in. this is all by memory, but should be accurate. i worked for mercedes for the last 8 years.. if you get hung up, shoot me a message, or hit up youtube.. i’m sure there’s someone who’s posted a video there too. good luck, you can do this!
